label: All Views
description: Event calendar with all views and live settings. Best for a feature tour whose tabbed Settings popover drives view options, time grid, drag behavior, 6 languages and 5 time zones.

label: Room Bookings
description: Event calendar with resource view for room bookings. Best for hotel rooms as columns from 8:00 to 20:00, holding stays, check-outs and housekeeping colored by a status legend.

label: Event Form Dialog
description: Event calendar with create and edit dialog. Best for a single form dialog that opens blank on an empty day or the toolbar, and edits or deletes whatever you click.

label: Custom Event Chips
description: Event calendar with custom event chips. Best for project bars spanning several days in a Monday first month, led by a track icon, with hover tooltips and a legend.

label: Drag-to-Book
description: Event calendar with drag-to-book appointments. Best for a consultant's day from 9:00 to 18:00 where dragging over free time books a slot and overlapping draws are refused.
